prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop web dashboard screenshot for GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, route Evolução, 1600x1000 landscape. Apply the chosen "Folhas de Operação" direction shown in the supplied overview reference: warm ivory stock, black/graphite text, cobalt selected controls and plots, discreet chrome-yellow section markers, fine folio rules and restrained transparent sheets. Clear operational hierarchy and readable labels. No browser chrome, no device frame, no decorative gradients. Preserve exact product name, logo and Portuguese terms.

Persistent left navigation: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução selected, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Top header breadcrumb "Operacional › Evolução"; centered clipped scrolling city update ticker with green refresh icon and "Sincronizado", sample visible sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", edge fades indicating horizontal scroll; theme/user at right. City and date values are illustrative.

Show the complete common dashboard filter beneath header, two rows, no omissions: "Período", mode "Ano/Semana" selected / "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07"; then separate selects "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", action "Limpar".

Main panel eyebrow "Evolução", title "Evolução mensal", descriptive text "Acompanhe corridas e horas ao longo do tempo com métricas selecionáveis." Put the real toggle "Mensal" / "Semanal" with Mensal selected, plus selectable metric controls; show named available series as "Pedidos" and "Horas" (use only these two in chart). Dominant readable 12-period line chart across the work area with understated grid, clear month labels and legend. Below, four measured summary folio tiles with exact labels "Total de pedidos", "Total de horas", "Média mensal", "Período analisado", including subtext such as "12 meses analisados", "Tempo total trabalhado", "Pedidos por período", "12 meses disponíveis". Use restrained yellow highlights on active period and divider tabs. All plotted values illustrative placeholders, not real data. Keep the global filter and ticker fully visible above the chart.
title: Folhas de Operação — Evolução
demoData: Séries e indicadores demonstrativos; não usar como dados do Supabase.
